table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AdvanceCode,
	DATE=Date,
	UserCode=UserCode, 
	AccCode=AccCode,
	EmpAdvAccCode,
	EmpCode = (SELECT E.EmpCode FROM Emp_Employee E WHERE E.AdvAccCode=Emp_Advance.EmpAdvAccCode),
	EmpID = (SELECT E.EMPID FROM Emp_Employee E WHERE E.AdvAccCode=Emp_Advance.EmpAdvAccCode),
	EMPCatCode = (SELECT E.EMPCatCode FROM Emp_Employee E WHERE E.AdvAccCode=Emp_Advance.EmpAdvAccCode),
	DeptCode = (SELECT E.DeptCode FROM Emp_Employee E WHERE E.AdvAccCode=Emp_Advance.EmpAdvAccCode),
	DesigCode = (SELECT E.DesigCode FROM Emp_Employee E WHERE E.AdvAccCode=Emp_Advance.EmpAdvAccCode),
	Amount,
	ReturnedAmt,
	Installment,
	GLVochCode,
	RefNo,
	Remarks
FROM 
	Emp_Advance
WHERE
	AdvanceCode = :ai_code
